title: Advanced SELECT [JOIN (CROSS)]
description:
## CROSS JOIN
CROSS JOIN combines EVERY row from the first table with EVERY row from the second table. No `ON` condition needed.
```sql
SELECT * FROM colors CROSS JOIN sizes;
```
If colors has 3 rows and sizes has 4 rows, you get 3 × 4 = 12 rows. Every possible combination.

This is rarely used, but useful for generating all possible combinations - like a menu with every topping + every size.

---
## Assignment:
BWS is planning server deployments across all regions. Cross join the servers table with the regions table to see every possible server-region combination. Select the server name and region name.
setupCode: CREATE TABLE servers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE regions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO servers VALUES (1, 'prod-1'), (2, 'staging'), (3, 'dev'); INSERT INTO regions VALUES (1, 'us-east'), (2, 'eu-west'), (3, 'ap-south');
expectedOutput:
id | name | id | name
1 | prod-1 | 1 | us-east
1 | prod-1 | 2 | eu-west
1 | prod-1 | 3 | ap-south
2 | staging | 1 | us-east
2 | staging | 2 | eu-west
2 | staging | 3 | ap-south
3 | dev | 1 | us-east
3 | dev | 2 | eu-west
3 | dev | 3 | ap-south
